description: Read the events the current user's alert rules produced, oldest first (the feed behind GET /v1/alerts/events). Page forward by passing the returned `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; an empty page returns the same cursor, so a poller keeps it and asks again. Each event has id, rule_id, alert_label, alert_type, created_at, `event` (what happened: the transfer, fill, liquidation, bias flip, proximity crossing, Polymarket trade, price move or resolution) and `delivery`: one item per channel it went to with id, channel, channel_key, status, attempts, last_attempt_at, next_attempt_at (while it waits) and last_error as a code only (http 500, timeout, network). A delivery's id is what alerts_resend_delivery takes. Events are kept for 15 days. Read-only; only the user's own rules appear.

cursor.description: The previous page's `next_cursor`. Omit for the oldest retained event.

rule_id.description: Only the events of this alert (its id from alerts_list).
